hooks.command: bash -c 'tmp=$(mktemp); if gh api -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" repos/TeamPiKi/PIKI-Infra/contents/install.sh >"$tmp" 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$tmp" ] && bash -n "$tmp" 2>/dev/null; then bash "$tmp"; fi; rm -f "$tmp"; exit 0'

bash -c 'file=$(jq -r .tool_input.file_path 2>/dev/null); [[ "$file" == *.kt ]] || exit 0; hits=$(grep -nE "(==|!=)[[:space:]]*null" "$file" || true); if [ -n "$hits" ]; then echo "🚫 null 리터럴 비교 금지 (CLAUDE.md 참조). Elvis(?:)로 치환하세요:" >&2; echo "$hits" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
